scope: 第六轮固定模型首次使用确认子集；仅工程确认，不是官方测试或正式统计结论
selection_rule: Sort fixed validation scene IDs after excluding all previously used validation scenes; take the first five without reading their frames or scores
checkpoint_selection: Both fixed v5 final local-step1600 checkpoints; inherited v3 step1600; zero new optimizer updates
decision_rule: Adopt center_mse only if its absolute gate and all three relative rules pass; otherwise retain original only if original passes its absolute gate; otherwise neither arm confirmed. A candidate absolute pass without relative support does not confirm adoption.
failure_branch: Archive all results as a completed experiment with failed effect gate. Do not tune on or reopen this report. These five scenes become development validation; design a new version from error evidence while leaving remaining five validation scenes, calibration and official test untouched. Independent grasp-engineering readiness may continue without claiming segmentation efficacy.
success_branch: Record engineering confirmation and proceed with grasp baseline integration/readiness; no formal superiority or grasp success claim.
recovery: Commit both models for one frame atomically with checksum; bind protocol, source, data, checkpoints and library versions. Commit first two frames then resume full80 and verify prefix bytes unchanged. This is process-segment recovery, not physical power-cut testing.
exclusions: No calibration or official test data
No training, threshold change or checkpoint selection
No treating80 correlated frames as80 independent scenes
Ascending scene IDs are deterministic but not representative random sampling
After first evaluation this subset is development validation, not permanently blind
No candidate relabeling or post-result threshold relaxation
